=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: `SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES` is referenced three times in the new code but is never defined anywhere in the repository. The PR description claims "It reuses `SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES` and the `created=>${IMPL_CREATED_AFTER}` window from the run-ID capture", but no run-ID capture helper in this step uses or sets this name.
  WHY: The step runs with `set -euo pipefail` (line 953 of the base file, unchanged by the PR). The first reference inside the `$(summarize_scoped_impl_runs)` subshell — the while-loop condition — raises "SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES: unbound variable", the subshell exits, and `IMPL_SCOPED_RC=1` is recorded as an "unreadable page" — even when every page actually read fine. The `|| IMPL_SCOPED_RC=$?` makes the helper appear to fail gracefully, but in reality the helper never executes a single page read. On every later terminal check the same failure repeats (until the IMPL_SCOPED_UNREADABLE_AT throttle elapses), the step never confirms whether our Implement run finished, and a genuine Implement failure is masked as an inactivity timeout. The PR's central feature — "confirm our Implement runs finished before failing `wait-implement`" — is broken end-to-end.
  Line or code reference: New `summarize_scoped_impl_runs` function (lines added in the 1215-1308 hunk), specifically the while-loop condition `while [ "$impl_summary_page" -le "$SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES" ]` and the cap check `if [ "$impl_summary_page" -eq "$SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES" ]`; the terminal branch's CAPPED echo message `an earlier walk found every page up to ${SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES} full`.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: PR description "Verification (evidence)" first bullet — "python3 tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py: **35 passed** (the 26 existing tests plus the 9 new ones)"; and the "Changes" section enumeration of new test cases (which lists 9 names: `test_implement_keeps_waiting_while_our_run_is_active_behind_other_completed_runs`, `test_implement_fails_with_our_run_id_when_our_run_completed_without_a_pr`, `test_implement_fails_when_no_run_ran_for_our_issue`, `test_implement_keeps_waiting_when_our_run_is_listed_after_an_empty_walk`, `test_implement_treats_an_unreadable_page_as_unknown_until_the_inactivity_limit`, `test_implement_walks_again_after_an_unreadable_page_once_the_retry_interval_passed`, `test_implement_treats_a_capped_walk_as_unknown_and_reads_at_most_ten_pages`, `test_implement_walks_again_once_the_cached_run_completes`, `test_implement_throttles_the_walk_when_the_cached_run_cannot_be_read`).
  Expected change site: PR description body (the "Verification (evidence)" first bullet and the "Changes" test-file bullet) and the `tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py` enumeration. The PR also relies on the round 4 commit message's "36/36 guard tests pass" claim.
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff adds 10 new `def test_implement_*` functions, not 9 — `test_implement_times_the_confirming_walk_from_the_end_of_the_empty_walk` is the 10th and is missing from the PR description's enumeration. The base test file (`tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py`) contains 3 tests, not 26 (the file is 65 lines, with `test_other_active_plan_runs_avoids_inline_fallback_substitution`, `test_plan_runs_payload_is_shape_validated_before_counting`, `test_other_active_plan_runs_is_numeric_before_arithmetic_comparison`). The actual test count after the diff lands is therefore 3 + 10 = 13, not 26 + 9 = 35 nor 36. The "26 existing tests" figure in the PR description does not correspond to any test file the PR touches or to the count at any prior point in the conversation, and the round 4 "36/36" commit-message and judgment numbers do not match either. The verification claim in the PR body is therefore factually incorrect on every numeric field (existing count, new count, total), and the enumeration drops the round-4-added test. The "35 passed"/"36/36" figures also cannot be reached by the diff as written because of the BLOCKER in CORRECTNESS & LOGIC: the missing `SCOPED_RUN_LOOKUP_MAX_PAGES=10` setting means every new test that reaches `summarize_scoped_impl_runs` exits with an unbound-variable error under `set -euo pipefail`.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
